AntiPattern.WhyBad: Private env imported into a universal/client module (`AX_SK_SERVER_CLIENT_BOUNDARY`). Build refuses to bundle it; even if it slipped through (e.g., via dynamic require), the secret would be shipped to the browser bundle. Boundary violation is a security failure, not a stylistic one.
AntiPattern.Good: Move the consumer to `+page.server.ts` or `$lib/server/...`; expose only the derived value the client legitimately needs through the load return.
